answer_1.quote: We employ five different models: BART, vanilla T5, UnifiedQA-v2 which uses a T5 backbone and has been fine-tuned on other QA datasets but not on HotpotQA, LLaMA-7B and Alpaca-7B.
answer_1.outputs: The model generates answers to multi-step questions, either directly or via decomposition steps.

answer_2.quote: All bars are the mean of three random seeds and error bars indicate the standard deviation. We see that most methods perform nearly the same, except for two that underperform: Explicit and Explicit + Implicit.
